input: Daniel's Head Beach Park, Scotts Hill, Bermuda
note: Lands 42.43,-87.86 — ILLINOIS, 2,311 km off. Venue is null (the park name becomes the locality), 'Scotts Hill' becomes the region, and the country token is again out-competed by the US Bermudas. The park IS in OSM as a way; it is the admin gazetteer that has neither it nor Scotts Hill.

Lands 43.82,-69.71 — coastal MAINE, 1,354 km off. The islet is absent from the admin gazetteer, and 'Bermuda' is a trap of its own: WOF carries FOUR US localities named Bermuda alongside the country record (id 9000000119609), so the country token has same-named domestic competition. A number-word venue shape ('Five Star') on top.
